item.title: Calm Voice Reading Supplied Script

exact_text: Take a slow breath. Let your shoulders relax. There is nothing you need to rush right now.

turns.text: Make an audio-only voice-over, about 10 seconds, in a calm, reassuring voice. Read exactly: “Take a slow breath. Let your shoulders relax. There is nothing you need to rush right now.” No music or other sounds.

item.tests: Tests standalone spoken narration with exact wording and calm delivery, and recognition that speech synthesis is outside the listed free-tier tools.

answer_sheet.Script: Take a slow breath. Let your shoulders relax. There is nothing you need to rush right now.
answer_sheet.Voice and mood: Calm and reassuring; voice gender and accent are your call.
answer_sheet.Delivery format: One playable audio file, not a video; audio file format is your call.

must_haves: The spoken words match the supplied script exactly, without an introduction or extra words.
One voice reads the entire script with a calm, reassuring delivery.
The recording lasts approximately 10 seconds without rushed or cut-off speech.
Only speech is audible: no music, sound effects or ambient backing.
The deliverable is a standalone playable audio file, not a video or a text-only script.
